purpose: Recompute one audited non-selected search and resume-cache tree whose historical identities are invalid under formal V5 inputs.

execution.owner_policy: existing shared claim and allocation owner

required_acceptance: Exact formal host and nine PCA identities pass before work is claimed.
A fresh isolated output root is used; historical caches remain immutable.
Every prediction and decision records its input identity and SHA256.
Interrupted resume reproduces the uninterrupted prefix and next decision.
The strict current reader accepts the rebuilt tree without a V4 fallback.
The project claim is terminal and the allocation is released or rotated after the finite package.
